title: German Sausage Pasta
description: A classic German-inspired pasta dish with spicy sausage and rich umami flavors.

ingredients.name: Aji
ingredients.notes: Asian hot sauce, adjust to taste

ingredients.name: Acrylunchy
ingredients.notes: any type of crunchy vegetable, such as bell peppers or carrots

ingredients.name: Umami
ingredients.notes: mushroom or soy sauce, adjust to taste

instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Cook the pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, cook the sliced sausage over medium-high heat until browned and cooked through.
Add the crunchy vegetables to the skillet and cook until tender.
Stir in the aji, umami, and cooked pasta.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or chives if desired.
